title: omnicrawl target declaration
description: A target site's rules for omnisense/omnicrawl: whether collection is allowed, on what authority, with what reference and date, its rate limits, what may be stored and republished. A list of them, or {"targets": [...]}, is what Targets::fromFile() reads. Rules the schema cannot say and Target enforces at load time: every authority but robots-only needs a reference and a date, so does a refusal and any declaration that allows crawl-runs; robots.honour false only under own-site or written-permission, with a reason; rateLimits [] only for own-site; a refusal needs a reason.

target.description: A host, "*.host" (its subdomains), either with a path prefix ("example.org/news/").

reference.description: Where the authority can be checked: the terms' address, the permission's document, the site.

date.description: When the permission was given or the terms read.

rateLimits.description: Per host. null or absent: the family's default (1 every 10 s, 100 a day).
